messages:
nina: heads-up: deploy-bot failed promoting the staging candidate. ECR refused the put-image. tag `release-candidate-21mar` blocked due to immutability and KMS mismatch. anyone here?

deploy-bot: automated: publish attempt -> AWS ECR error 409 TagAlreadyExists; KMS:AccessDenied when trying to use org kms key for cross-account push. repo `redwood/ingest` target tag `release-candidate-21mar`, digest sha256:dd33ee...77.

chris: I think CI used the same tag for two builds. our org repo enforces immutability and only org KMS can be used. deploy-bot tried to push from builder account with builder key.

infra: short options: (1) manual re-push into org account using org kms (requires reattaching cosign attestations), (2) pin staging to source digest so QA continues, (3) rollback to previous digest.

nina: prefer option 2 now so QA can finish smoke fast. manual repush for prod can follow.

qa-bot: smoke tests queued against sha256:dd33ee...77. ETA 5m.

ops-bot: policy: staging digest pin allowed with explicit approver reaction. Please react :white_check_mark: to proceed. Prod promotions remain blocked until org-push+attest.

release-lead: pinging QA and infra. we have a 22:00 UTC window in ~2h. if manual repush+attest completes in <60m we keep slot; otherwise slide.

chris: I'll open a CI follow-up to append build-id to promotion tags to avoid reuse.

nina: approved for staging digest-pin. ops-bot set flag `staging_pinned=sha256:dd33ee...77`.

ops-bot: flag set. Automated prod promotions suspended.

qa-bot: smoke passed 4/4. QA signs off.

infra: I'll do manual repush now: will pull manifest by digest from CI account and put-image to org account with org kms, then reattach attestations with cosign.

deploy-bot: reminder: put-image won't transfer attestations. infra must attach cosign blobs and run verify.

infra: manual repush complete. cosign attach-blob done; cosign verify OK. pushed tag `release-candidate-21mar` in org account.

ops-bot: prod_release_ok=true for this artifact.

release-lead: good work. plan: (1) update prod manifests to imageDigest sha256:dd33ee...77, (2) dry-run canary, (3) rollout 5%->50%->100% with 10m waits. chris, follow-up ticket for CI tag uniqueness?

chris: created ticket DEPLOY-4602 and opened PR to append build-id.

nina: adding a note to release notes: "Ingest: promoted to staging pinned by digest due to cross-account KMS + immutability; manual org republish and attestation done for prod."

release-lead: keeping thread open until full prod rollout completes. thanks all.
